scope: Isolated Apple VirtualMac; experimental network-location barrier, not release qualification
savedLocationBeforeBoot: Empty test location, committed without applying to the running system
cleanup: Original Automatic location restored and applied; temporary launch job removed
limitations: The guest stalled during shutdown; Tart stop/start was needed for the cold start.
This is not packet attribution from the first instant of boot.
Apple InterfaceNamer may add default configuration for newly discovered interfaces.
Committing and applying the normal location before re-arming isolation would leave a persistence window.
This experiment is not installed as production boot protection.
